final: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as overall_avg FROM line_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT lt.link_to_budget, lt.total_cost, lt.expense_count, lt.total_cost - av.overall_avg as excess FROM line_totals lt CROSS JOIN avg_total av WHERE lt.total_cost > av.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_of_above_avg_totals, SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses_above_avg, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_amount FROM above_avg
